volume_dump_requires_meta.name: volume_dump_requires_meta
volume_dump_requires_meta.value: backup_strategy != 'dump' OR backup_meta IS NOT NULL OR backup_spec IS NOT NULL

cron_job_command_needs_app.name: cron_job_command_needs_app
cron_job_command_needs_app.value: type <> 'command' OR app_id IS NOT NULL

user_star_one_target.name: user_star_one_target
user_star_one_target.value: ("user_star"."kind" = 'project' AND "user_star"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "user_star"."app_id" IS NULL) OR ("user_star"."kind" = 'app' AND "user_star"."app_id" IS NOT NULL AND "user_star"."project_id" IS NULL)
